entities.name: Kraken
entities.description: Species of massive sea fiends from the deepest reaches of the ocean, found on many planes.

entities.name: Gyruda
entities.description: Legendary demon kraken from the plane of Ikoria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane whose oceans are inhabited by krakens.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane where krakens are feared destroyers; Thassa uses them as harbingers.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea on Theros who uses kraken as harbingers of her wrath.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane whose krakens are sapient beings.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: Plane with a kraken in the central lake of Ferara Park.

entities.name: Time Rift crisis
entities.description: Crisis on Dominaria during which large krakens entered its seas through rifts.

events.summary: During the Time Rift crisis, large krakens enter Dominaria's seas through the rifts and remain in the deep sea.
events.quote: large krakens entered Dominaria's seas through the rifts

relations.note: uses kraken as harbingers of her wrath
relations.quote: Thassa is known to use kraken as harbingers of her wrath.
Gyruda is a legendary demon kraken from the plane of Ikoria.
